items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: Yes I did. We played I think almost 15 years off and on.

ctx.x: And you spent some years accompanying Kim Parker?

Yes I did. We played I think almost 15 years off and on. Of course not all the time but off and on. And I still have contact with her. I also got to know her fantastic mother, Chan Parker, the wife of Bird. So for example we went to her home, she lived outside Paris, in a 200 year old house or something, and at the bottom floor it was just one big room. It had a kitchen where you eat, you had the living room, and you had the music department. So it was like that. And on the walls there was “Best Alto Saxophone…
I wonder if Chan was able to live off any of Charlie Parker’s estate, or if there was such a thing.
